text:
Petrarch celebrated his fair Laura with genius and lofty style, and made his care eternal to the world, and the rare beauty he saw in her.


Many live envious of her, for so high a good and fortunate state, against which time can do nothing, deserves great envy.


I alone would wish to leave you, gallant, beautiful Silvia, to whom I gave my heart in sacrifice, the same good fortune.


For this soul, happy in adoring you, can render only this service: that neither time nor death offend you.

translation.title: Petrarch Celebrated His Fair Laura
